\documentclass[border=4pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=newest}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \begin{axis}[
    width=8cm,
    height=6cm,
    view={55}{35},
    domain=-1:1,
    y domain=-1:1,
    samples=11,
    xlabel={$x$},
    ylabel={$y$},
    zlabel={$T$},
    title={Temperature field},
    grid=major,
    colorbar right,
    colorbar style={ytick={0,0.5,1,1.5,2},title={$T$}}
  ]
    \addplot3[surf] {x*x + y*y};
  \end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
